map.精馏收率与物料平衡 使用指南: Distillation Yield and Material Balance User Guide
map.输入精馏装置总进料量及各产品（塔顶、塔底、侧线）产量，工具逐产品核算收率，并汇总: Enter the total feed and the output of each product (overhead, bottoms, side draw) of the distillation unit; the tool checks yield per product and totals the material balance to see whether feed and output agree, helping operators spot metering deviations and light-ends losses.
map.常减压/裂解装置物料平衡：给定进料量(吨)与各馏分产量，工具逐产品算收率并汇总总: Material balance for atmospheric-vacuum units / crackers: given feed (tonnes) and each fraction's output, the tool computes per-product yield and totals the overall yield, loss/residual liquid, and judges whether the unit runs in balance.
map.方案比选：对比不同操作条件下的产品分布(如多产丙烯方案)，用收率条形直观比较各馏: Scheme selection: compare product distributions under different operating conditions (e.g. a high-propylene option), comparing each fraction's share with yield bars to assist process optimization.
map.损耗核查：当总收率明显偏离 100%(损失率>5%)会高亮「偏差较大」，提示计量: Loss check: when the total yield deviates clearly from 100% (loss rate >5%) it highlights "large deviation", flagging metering error or unaccounted by-products/loss items.
map.算例：进料 1000 吨的两产品分布: Worked example: two-product distribution from 1000 t feed
map.：进料 feed=1000 t，产品 乙烯 480 t、丙烯 290 t（其余为:
: feed=1000 t, products ethylene 480 t and propylene 290 t (the rest are by-products/losses not listed separately).
Ethylene yield=480/1000×100%=48.0%; propylene yield=290/1000×100%=29.0%; total product=770 t; total yield=77.0%; loss/residual=1000-770=230 t; loss rate=23.0%. A loss rate >5% is judged "large deviation"; check by-product metering or loss items.
map.收率和物料平衡怎么算？: How are yield and material balance computed?
map.单产品收率=该产品产量÷进料量×100%；总收率=所有产品产量之和÷进料量×10: Single-product yield = that product's output ÷ feed × 100%; total yield = sum of all product outputs ÷ feed × 100%; loss = feed − total product, loss rate = loss ÷ feed × 100%. With a good balance the total yield approaches 100%.
map.损失来自塔底残渣、未冷凝轻组分、设备挂壁与计量误差，以及未单独列出的副产品。损失: Loss comes from bottom residue, uncondensed light ends, wall film in equipment, metering error, and by-products not listed separately. A persistently high loss rate calls for checking operation and design, but small losses are normal in continuous distillation.
